payload.core_composition_summary: Uses simple arithmetic and conditionals to directly compute min and max off days based on number of full weeks and remainder, employing a single greedy allocation logic.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a straightforward greedy strategy: each full week contributes 2 off days; remaining days are placed to maximize/minimize overlap with weekends. No multiple algorithm mechanisms are combined; it's a single-step math-based allocation.
